text:
Anna: Quick thought — building a "Preview impact" in the Permissions editor that simulates effective routing + quota changes if you edit roles. Need to decide: do we run the canonical evaluation on the server or approximate client-side for instant feedback?

Kevin: Client-side feels much nicer UX (no wait). But we’ll duplicate auth logic, risk divergence, and cached data might be stale. Also trickier for tenants with huge role graphs.

Sasha: Server-side is accurate (uses current entitlements + route affinity) and can apply heavier heuristics, but every preview is another eval call -> telemetry/cost concerns.

Ravi: Proposal: hybrid. Client returns fast approximated preview using local cache/graph; we kick an async server eval and surface canonical result when ready. If mismatch > threshold we show a small warning. Minimal extra API surface:
```
POST /v1/admin/permissions/preview
{
  "role_ids": ["role:customer_support"],
  "target": "/v1/generate",
  "sample_rate": 0.05,
  "include_cost_estimate": true
}
```

Marta: Telemetry flag: we should never log full ACL graphs in previews. Log only diffs + anonymized cost delta. Also rate-limit per-org preview calls (burst 5/min?).

devex-bot: RFC draft created: https://go.redwood/rfc/perm-preview (added initial API sketch and UX mocks) :thumbsup:

Anna: Rollout idea: dark-launch server-side evals behind feature-flag, enable for 10% of orgs, compare client-preview vs server result for first 5000 previews, compute mismatch rate. If mismatch < 2% we flip to server-as-source-of-truth for UI.

Kevin: Important: show microcopy in the editor — "Preview is an estimate; final permissions enforced by server." And an inline link to "Why results might differ".

Sasha: Telemetry event proposal (minimal): `perm_preview.result` => [org_id, user_id (hashed), endpoint, mismatch_flag, cost_delta_usd, sample_tag]

Ravi: For cost estimates, baseline: sum(route_qps * role_affinity_multiplier * avg_tokens_per_call) -> convert to USD with model-unit-cost. Keep as conservative estimate.

Marta: I'll draft the microcopy + user-facing tooltip. Suggest the tooltip say: "Estimates can differ when caches are stale or when your org uses delegated roles. Use the server preview to confirm."

Kevin: Guardrail: if server eval fails or times out, fall back to "Client approx" and show a small amber badge. Don’t block the user.

Anna: Owners: Ravi -> server API + sampling; Kevin -> client approximation; Marta -> microcopy + UX; Sasha -> telemetry schema + PII review. I’ll open tasks and the canary flag.

Marta: :thumbsup: will sync with legal on minimal telemetry fields.

Anna: Thanks — will file the PR for the feature flag and the RFC link is the single source for now.

Kevin: One last nit — add an admin toggle to disable previews entirely for high-security customers.

Anna: Agreed. Add `permissions.preview.enabled` toggle at org-level.

Ravi: Sounds good, i'll add sampling and backoff.

Anna: End — filing tasks now.
